content.title: CBSE Class 10 Result 2026 (OUT) LIVE: CBSE Opens Second Board Exam LOC Window Today
content.text: CBSE Class 10th Result LIVE, CBSE Board Result News LIVE Updates: The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has declared the Class 10 Board Session 1 Examination 2026 results, with an overall pass percentage of 93.70%. Girls have once again outperformed boys, recording a pass percentage of 94.99%, while boys stood at 92.60%. Students can access their CBSE Class 10 results 2026 on the official websites, cbse.gov.in and results.cbse.nic.in, as well as via the UMANG app and DigiLocker using their login credentials.This year's result reflects a marginal improvement over 2025. Out of 24,83,479 registered candidates, 24,71,777 appeared for the examination, and 23,16,008 have qualified.In 2025, 23,85,079 students registered for the exam, 23,71,939 appeared, and 22,21,636 passed, resulting in a pass percentage of 93.66%. Compared to last year, the 2026 pass rate has increased by 0.04 percentage points, indicating a steady but limited upward trend in performance.Among school categories, Kendriya Vidyalayas (KVs) have emerged as the top performers with a 99.57% pass rate, followed closely by Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas (JNVs) at 99.42%. Government schools recorded a pass percentage of 91.43%, government-aided schools stood at 91.01%, while private schools registered 93.77%.CBSE Class 10 Result 2026 LIVE Updates: Track Here All The Latest Updates CBSE Class 10 Result 2026 (OUT) LIVE: CBSE To Open Class 10 Second Board Exam LOC Window Today, Check Details The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) is set to open the List of Candidates (LOC) submission window today for the Class 10 second board examination 2026. Schools can complete the registrations by April 22. CBSE Class 10 Result 2026 (OUT) LIVE: Application Window Opens For Private Candidates For Second Exam The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has invited applications from private candidates for the Class 10 Second Board Examination 2026, scheduled to be held in May. Students who appeared in the Class 10 first session examinations are allowed to improve their performance in up to three subjects through the Second Board Examination. Additionally, candidates from the 2025 session who were placed in the Compartment category are also eligible to appear under the third chance compartment provision. Check Who Can Apply, Application Schedule, Exam Pattern, Syllabus, Key Instructions, Important Guidelines Here CBSE Class 10 Second Board Exam 2026: Schedule For Submission Of Candidates' List Out The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has released the schedule for the submission of the List of Candidates (LOC) for the Class 10 Second Board Examination 2026.The schedule for payment of examination fees and submission of the LOC is as follows:Schedule For LOC Submission And Fee PaymentExamination Fee Payment - Phase 1: April 16, 2026 (around noon) to April 20, 2026LOC Submission and Fee Payment - Phase 2: April 16, 2026 to April 20, 2026LOC Submission and Fee Payment - Phase 3 (with late fee): April 21, 2026 to April 22, 2026Important InstructionsCandidates who wish to appear in the second board examination but whose names were not submitted during the first phase of LOC can now submit their names and pay the examination fee.Candidates whose names were submitted during the first phase are required to pay the examination fee.Candidates who had submitted their names earlier but no longer wish to appear in the Second Board Examination may withdraw their candidature.Candidates are also allowed to change their Mathematics option in the Second Board Examination:Students who opted for Mathematics (Standard) in the main examination may switch to Mathematics (Basic).Students who opted for Mathematics (Basic) may switch to Mathematics (Standard). CBSE Class 10 Result 2026 LIVE: Pass Percentage Rises To 93.70%, Slight Improvement Over Last Year The CBSE Class 10 Result 2026 shows a marginal improvement in overall performance compared to 2025. This year, out of 24,83,479 registered students, 24,71,777 appeared for the examination, and 23,16,008 students passed. The overall pass percentage stands at 93.70 per cent.In 2025, 23,85,079 students had registered for the exams, of which 23,71,939 appeared and 22,21,636 passed, resulting in a pass percentage of 93.66 per cent.Overall, the pass percentage has increased by 0.04 percentage points in 2026, indicating a slight but steady improvement in results. CBSE Class 10 Result 2026 LIVE: CWSN Students Record 96.24% Pass Rate, 9,088 Clear Exam Children With Special Needs (CWSN) have recorded a strong performance in the CBSE Class 10 Result 2026, with 9,443 students appearing for the exam and 9,088 successfully passing it. The overall pass percentage stands at 96.24 per cent. Additionally, 452 students scored above 90 per cent, while 91 students secured above 95 per cent. CBSE Class 10 Result 2026 LIVE: 8.96% Students Score Above 90%, 2.24% Cross 95% Mark According to the CBSE data, 8.96 per cent of students have scored 90 per cent and above in the Class 10 examination 2026. Meanwhile, 2.24 per cent of students have secured 95 per cent and above. CBSE 10th Result 2026 (OUT) LIVE: 99.10% Students From CBSE-Affiliated Foreign Schools Clear Exam Students from CBSE-affiliated schools abroad have recorded a 99.10 per cent pass rate in the Class 10 results 2026. This marks an improvement over last year’s 98.57 per cent, reflecting a consistent upward trend in performance across international centres. CBSE 10th Result 2026 (OUT) LIVE: Kendriya Vidyalayas Lead With 99.57% Pass Rate, Top Among All Institutions Kendriya Vidyalayas (KVs) have emerged as the best-performing school category in the CBSE Class 10 Result 2026, recording a 99.57 per cent pass rate. Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas (JNVs) followed closely with 99.42 per cent. Among other school categories, government schools recorded 91.43 per cent, government-aided schools 91.01 per cent, while private schools stood at 93.77 per cent. CBSE 10th Result 2026 (OUT) LIVE: No Topper List, Merit Rank Released, Board Continues Policy To Avoid Competition The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has not released any topper list for the Class 10 results 2026, in line with its earlier decision to discourage unhealthy academic competition among students. The Board also does not award first, second, or third divisions to students.However, CBSE will issue merit certificates to the top 0.1 per cent of students who have secured the highest marks in individual subjects. These merit certificates will be made available in the students’ DigiLocker accounts after the conclusion of the second board examinations. CBSE 10th Result 2026 (OUT) LIVE: Trivandrum, Vijayawada Top with 99.79% Pass Rate CBSE Class 10 results 2026 show strong regional performance, with Trivandrum and Vijayawada emerging at the top of the list, each recording an impressive 99.79% pass percentage. Chennai closely follows with 99.58%, while both Delhi regions also deliver strong results, Delhi West at 97.45% and Delhi East at 97.33%.At the other end of the spectrum, Guwahati has recorded the lowest pass percentage among all regions at 85.32%. CBSE 10th Result 2026 (OUT) LIVE: CBSE Class 10 Result 2026: Overall Pass Percentage Stands At 93.70%, Girls Outperform Boys The overall pass percentage for the CBSE Class 10 Session 1 examination 2026 stands at 93.70 per cent. As per the official data, girls have outperformed boys once again with a pass percentage of 94.99 per cent, while boys have recorded a pass percentage of 92.6 per cent. CBSE 10th Result 2026 (OUT) LIVE: Direct Link Active at cbseresults.nic.in, Students Can Check Scorecard Online The CBSE Class 10 Result 2026 can also be accessed through the official portal cbseresults.nic.in, as the direct result link has now been activated. Students can visit the website and check their scorecards online using their required login credentials. CBSE 10th Result 2026 (OUT) LIVE: CBSE Class 10th Result 2026: Who Is Eligible For Second Board Exam? The CBSE has introduced the Two Board Examination policy from the 2026 exam session, as notified on June 25, 2025. As per the recommendations of the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, Class 10 students will be given an opportunity to improve their performance in up to three subjects during the second board examination in May 2026.With the announcement of the Class 10 first exam result on April 15, 2026, students can finally decide whether to appear for the second board exam. According to the March 17 notice, the list of candidates will be submitted by the schools for all desirous students. Students planning to appear in the second board examination must note that change of subject is not allowed for the second exam. No correction in the student's data from the first exam to the second exam will be allowed by the board. CBSE 10th Result 2026 (OUT) LIVE: What is the minimum passing criteria for the CBSE Class 10 exam? Students are required to secure a minimum of 33 per cent marks overall to pass the CBSE Class 10 board examination. CBSE 10th Result 2026 (OUT) LIVE: When were the CBSE Class 10 board exams conducted in 2026? The CBSE Class 10 board examinations 2026 were conducted from February 17 to March 11, 2026. CBSE 10th Result 2026 (OUT) LIVE: Download Link, Official Websites Here The CBSE has declared the Class 10 board examination results 2026 today, April 15, 2026. Students who appeared for the examination can now check and download the results on the official websites results.cbse.nic.in and cbse.gov.in. A total of 24,71,777 students appeared for the Class 10 exams this year.CBSE 10th Result 2026: How To Download Class 10 Result Via Official Websites?Visit official CBSE website results.cbse.nic.in.Click on "Secondary School Examination (Class X) 2026" under the "2026 Results" section.Enter roll number, school number, admit card ID, date of birth, and security pin.Click on "Submit".Your marksheet will appear on the screen.Download and keep it for future use.CBSE Board Results 2026: Official Websites To Download Resultsresults.cbse.nic.incbse.gov.inresults.nic.inresults.digilocker.gov.inumang.gov.incbse.nic.in CBSE 10th Result 2026 Live: Is APAAR ID Mandatory To Check Your Score? The APAAR ID, which stands for Automated Permanent Academic Account Registry, is a unique ID introduced under the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020. Its main purpose is to store a student's academic records digitally in one place, making it easier to track their progress over time. While CBSE has started using APAAR ID during exam registrations and for maintaining records, it is mainly for administrative use.However, students are still encouraged to create or link their APAAR ID with DigiLocker. Doing this can make it easier to download official digital marksheets and certificates after the results are declared. It also helps in keeping academic documents safe and easily accessible in the future. Students can check their CBSE Class 10 results 2026 on the official websites, cbse.gov.in and results.cbse.nic.in, using their login credentials. The CBSE Class 10 examinations for 2026 were conducted between February 17 and March 11, with around 25 lakh students appearing for the exams. Students awaiting their scorecards can check their results on the UMANG platform as well as the official CBSE websites once the results are declared. Candidates are advised to keep their login credentials ready to access their marks without delay. While an official confirmation is still awaited, indications suggest that the results could be released anytime soon. Once declared, students will be able to access their scorecards on DigiLocker and the UMANG app, ensuring quick and convenient access for those who appeared for the examinations. CBSE Class 10 Result 2026 LIVE: How did different institutions perform in the CBSE Class 10 results 2025? In 2025, Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas (JNVs) recorded the highest pass percentage at 99.49%, followed closely by Kendriya Vidyalayas (KVs) at 99.45%, while independent schools achieved 94.17%, STSS schools recorded 91.53%, government schools recorded 89.26%, and government-aided schools had the lowest pass percentage at 83.94%. CBSE Class 10 Result 2026 LIVE: What is the gender-wise pass percentage in CBSE Class 10 results for 2024 and 2025? The gender-wise pass percentage shows that girls recorded 94.75% in 2024 and improved to 95.00% in 2025, while boys had a pass percentage of 92.71% in 2024, which slightly declined to 92.63% in 2025; transgender candidates showed a significant improvement, rising from 91.30% in 2024 to 95.00% in 2025, and overall, girls outperformed boys by 2.37 percentage points in 2025. CBSE Class 10 Result 2026 LIVE: What Was Last Year’s Pass Percentage? Out of 23,71,939 students who appeared for Class 10 exams 2025, a total of 22,21,636 students passed, resulting in a pass percentage of 93.66%, which shows a slight improvement of 0.06% compared to 2024. CBSE Class 10 Result 2026 LIVE: Thiruvananthapuram Maintains Top Rank Streak Among Cities Among cities, Thiruvananthapuram (Trivandrum) has remained a consistent top performer. Except for 2025, the city held the number one position in both Class 10 and Class 12 results from 2022 to 2024.Chennai and Vijayawada have also regularly featured among the top three cities. Bengaluru has remained a strong contender, frequently securing leading positions. In 2024, Vijayawada ranked second, while Bengaluru secured the second position in 2022 and 2023. Chennai maintained its presence in the top three across these years. CBSE Class 10 Result 2026 LIVE: These States And Cities Dominated Last Year An analysis of the 2025 results highlights the strong performance of southern regions. In the Class 12 examinations, Lakshadweep topped the chart with a perfect 100% pass percentage. Telangana followed with 99.73%, while Andhra Pradesh recorded 99.51%.Kerala and Tamil Nadu also featured among the top-performing regions, maintaining their consistent academic record.In the Class 10 results, Tamil Nadu and Kerala jointly secured the top position with an impressive pass percentage of 99.86%, further underlining the dominance of southern states. Once announced, students will be able to check their marks using their roll number. How To Check CBSE 10th Result 2025 By Roll NumberThrough the Official WebsiteVisit the CBSE result portal: results.cbse.nic.in.Click on the "CBSE Class 10 Result 2025" link.Enter your Roll Number, School Number, Admit Card ID, Date of Birth, and Security Pin.Submit the details to view your result.Using DigiLockerVisit cbse.digitallocker.gov.in.Click on the "Digital Documents" tab.Once the results are announced, click on the link for the CBSE Class 10 Marksheet.Enter your Roll Number and other login credentials to access your digital marksheet.Ensure you are registered on DigiLocker beforehand to access the result. CBSE Class 10 Result 2026 LIVE: How To Check Scores On UMANG App In Easy Steps The CBSE has made it easier to access marks through digital platforms, with the UMANG App emerging as one of the most convenient options. The app allows students to check their results smoothly, especially at a time when heavy traffic often slows down official websites due to lakhs of students logging in together.Easy way to check resultsStudents can check their Class 10 Result 2026 on the UMANG App by downloading it and logging in using their mobile number. They can then search for CBSE services and select the Class 10 Result 2026 link. After entering details such as roll number, school number, and admit card ID, students can view their marks instantly and also download the result for future use.Digital marksheet availableThe marksheet available on the app is provisional and can be used for immediate purposes such as admissions. Students can also access their official digital documents through DigiLocker, where CBSE uploads verified certificates.
